data.narrative:
Magrathea Metals is a Series A climate & energy company founded by Alex Grant and Jacob Brown that has raised $100M+. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the climate & energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with similar valuation tiers to support a reliable peer-median approach.

The analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, the only applicable triangulation method given data constraints. Using the $100M total raised as a base proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $200M. This reflects the expected valuation step between Series A and subsequent financing rounds in frontier-tech capital deployment patterns.

The quantitative analysis supports a valuation range of $170M (low) to $230M (high), with a median point of $200M. The narrow range reflects reliance on a single methodology rather than a convergence of multiple approaches. Key uncertainties include the absence of granular peer financial data at comparable stages, the inherent volatility in frontier-tech valuations, and the lack of disclosed comparable transaction multiples in the climate metals subsector. A peer-set expansion or disclosure of revenue/unit economics would materially strengthen the analysis.
